summary.zh: 青辣椒的「甜绿」咖喱，椰浆丰腴裹着香茅南姜的清香，最温柔的泰式咖喱。
summary.en: Fresh green chilies in a 'sweet green' curry — rich coconut milk wrapped around lemongrass and galangal.

ingredients.zh: 泰国小圆茄或长茄 1 个
ingredients.en: Thai pea eggplant or 1 long eggplant

ingredients.zh: 红尖椒、柠檬叶（可选，增香装饰）
ingredients.en: Red chili and kaffir lime leaves (optional)

steps.zh: 椰浆静置后舀出上层浓稠部分入锅，中火煮至油水分离、浮出椰油花。
steps.en: Scoop the thick cream from the top of the coconut milk into a pot; simmer until it splits and beads of coconut oil appear.

steps.zh: 下绿咖喱酱，在椰油中炒 2 分钟至香气完全释放。
steps.en: Fry the curry paste in that coconut oil for 2 minutes until deeply fragrant.

steps.zh: 下鸡块翻炒，让每块肉裹上咖喱酱。
steps.en: Add the chicken and toss until every piece wears the paste.

steps.zh: 倒入剩余椰浆和 100 毫升水，中火煮 10 分钟。
steps.en: Pour in the remaining coconut milk plus 100ml water; simmer 10 minutes over medium heat.

steps.zh: 加茄子块，以鱼露和棕榈糖调味——甜咸平衡是泰式咖喱的命门。
steps.en: Add the eggplant; season with fish sauce and palm sugar — that sweet-salty balance is the make-or-break.

steps.zh: 关火拌入罗勒叶和柠檬叶，配泰国香米饭上桌。
steps.en: Off the heat, fold in basil and lime leaves; serve over jasmine rice.

tips.zh: 先煮椰浆浓浆出「椰油花」再炒酱，香气与直接倒完全是两个世界。
tips.en: Cracking the coconut cream into oil before frying the paste is a different universe of aroma — don't just pour it all in.

tips.zh: 绿咖喱的「甜」是特点不是错误：鱼露的咸配棕榈糖的甜，边尝边调。
tips.en: Green curry is meant to be sweet-leaning — balance fish sauce against palm sugar, tasting as you go.

tips.zh: 罗勒关火后再放，用余温逼出香气，久煮香气全跑。
tips.en: Basil goes in off the heat — residual warmth releases its perfume; boiling kills it.

failChecks.zh: 油水分离难看：椰浆大火滚沸过度，中火慢煮即可（第一步出油花除外）。
failChecks.en: Ugly split sauce? You boiled the coconut milk too hard — medium heat, except when cracking the cream.

failChecks.zh: 只有辣没有香：咖喱酱没在椰油里先炒香。
failChecks.en: All heat, no fragrance? The paste wasn't fried in coconut oil first.

failChecks.zh: 太咸：鱼露要后放边尝，咖喱酱本身已含盐。
failChecks.en: Too salty? Add fish sauce last and taste — the paste already carries salt.

culturalStory.zh: 绿咖喱（แกงเขียวหวาน，「甜绿咖喱」）诞生于 20 世纪初的曼谷，比红咖喱年轻得多——新鲜青辣椒赋予它明亮的绿色与柔和的「甜」。椰浆的丰腴包裹着香茅、南姜与青柠叶的清香，让它成为对中国胃最友好的泰式咖喱，也是曼谷街头饭盒里的常客。
culturalStory.en: Green curry (gaeng khiao wan, 'sweet green curry') was born in early 20th-century Bangkok — much younger than red curry — with fresh green chilies lending its bright color and gentle sweetness. Rich coconut milk wrapped around lemongrass, galangal and kaffir lime makes it the friendliest Thai curry for newcomers, and a staple of Bangkok's street lunch boxes.
